name: ci-ubuntu-24.04-kvm-lane
setup: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 runner (4 vCPU, shared), QEMU/KVM Linux VM Space (2 vCPU, 2 GiB), same host, through the cua daemon, with this tree's cua-spacesd and the image's udev rule overlaid so the bulk lane carries files of 2 MiB and more; recorded by PR run 39498336835 on 2026-10-20. Before the lane, the same runner did 109 MiB/s down and 81 MiB/s up for 100 MiB (baseline of run 39358323548). Upload is bound by the guest's disk writes here, not by the transport. p50 only: hosted runners are too noisy for p95, and the workflow allows 2x.
